name: Chūō (Yamanashi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chūō city emblem in green, blue and orange: a green stylised leaf between blue and orange curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Chūō, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 December 2006.

features.role: Chūō city emblem — a green stylised leaf between blue and orange curved strokes
